_comment: AI App Directory - Updated weekly. Add new tools at the top with today's date as dateAdded. Fields: dateAdded (YYYY-MM-DD), lastUpdated (YYYY-MM-DD), trending (boolean)

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.description: OpenAI's flagship conversational AI. Handles everything from essay feedback to coding help to brainstorming session agendas.
values: Generate discussion questions, quiz items, or rubric drafts in seconds
Free tier handles most faculty tasks - GPT-4o included
Integrates with Canvas via plugins for in-platform use
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with GPT-4o. Plus at $20/mo adds more capacity and advanced features. Team plans available.
tools.bestFor: Faculty who need a versatile, general-purpose AI assistant for daily teaching tasks.
strengths: Extremely versatile across writing, analysis, and coding
limitations: Free tier has usage caps during peak hours
Output quality varies - prompt skill matters significantly
tools.quickstart: Start with: 'You are a helpful teaching assistant for [your course]. Help me draft three discussion questions about [topic] that target Bloom's analysis level.'

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: Anthropic's AI assistant built for nuanced, thoughtful analysis. Excels at long-form writing and careful reasoning.
values: 200K context window - paste entire textbooks or research papers
Strongest at nuanced writing feedback and academic tone
Built with safety-first design, less likely to fabricate citations
tools.priceDetail: Free tier available. Pro at $20/mo for higher usage limits and priority access. Team and Enterprise plans.
tools.bestFor: Faculty and researchers who need careful analysis of long documents, nuanced writing, or policy review.
strengths: Best-in-class at handling long documents (entire syllabi, papers, reports)
More cautious about uncertain claims - flags when it's unsure
Excellent writing quality with academic register
limitations: Can be overly cautious, sometimes declining reasonable requests
Web search is newer and less refined
tools.quickstart: Upload your syllabus and ask: 'Review this syllabus for clarity, consistency, and alignment between stated objectives and assessments. Flag any gaps.'

tools.name: Gemini
tools.description: Google's multimodal AI. Deep integration with Google Workspace makes it powerful for faculty already in the Google ecosystem.
values: Built into Google Docs, Sheets, Slides - works where you already work
Multimodal: analyze images, charts, and documents natively
Free tier is generous for individual use
tools.priceDetail: Free tier included with Google account. Advanced tier at $19.99/mo through Google One AI Premium.

tools.name: Perplexity AI
tools.description: AI-powered research engine that provides cited answers from real sources. Like Google Scholar meets a research assistant.
values: Every answer includes source citations - model research integrity for students
Academic focus mode searches scholarly databases specifically
Great for quick lit review scoping and fact-checking
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 5 Pro searches/day. Pro at $20/mo for unlimited searches and file uploads.

tools.name: Grok
tools.description: xAI's conversational AI with real-time information access. Direct, unfiltered communication style.
values: Real-time access to current events and breaking news
Less filtered responses - useful for devil's advocate exercises
Available through X (Twitter) platform
tools.priceDetail: Basic access free with X account. Full access requires X Premium subscription.

tools.name: Eduaide.Ai
tools.description: Purpose-built AI for educators. Creates lesson plans, assessments, differentiated materials, and IEP-aligned accommodations.
values: Over 100 education-specific generators - not a generic chatbot
Outputs aligned to standards (Common Core, state frameworks)
Creates differentiated versions for diverse learner needs automatically
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with limited generations. Pro plans for individual and institutional use.
tools.bestFor: Faculty who need production-ready lesson materials without spending hours formatting.
strengths: Education-specific - understands pedagogy, not just content
limitations: Generated content still needs instructor review and personalization
Some outputs feel templated - works best as a starting point
tools.quickstart: Select 'Lesson Plan' generator, input your subject, grade level, and standard. Review the output and customize timing and activities to fit your class.

tools.name: Brisk Teaching
tools.description: Chrome extension that works inside your existing platforms. Create, feedback, and differentiate directly in Google Docs, Canvas, and Schoology.
values: Works inside Canvas, Google Docs, Schoology - no tab switching
One-click reading level adjustment for any text
Generates instant feedback comments on student work
tools.priceDetail: Free for individual teachers. Premium features for institutions.

tools.name: Disco AI
tools.description: AI syllabus and course curriculum generator. Structures entire courses from learning objectives to assessment sequences.
values: Generates complete course structures from a topic description
Maps assessments back to learning objectives automatically
Collaborative - share and iterate with department colleagues
tools.priceDetail: Free basic plan. Pro and organizational plans available.

tools.name: Teachfloor
tools.description: Collaborative learning platform with AI-powered course creation, cohort management, and student engagement tools.
values: Cohort-based learning design - not just self-paced content
Built-in discussion, peer review, and group activity tools
AI assists with content structuring and activity design
tools.priceDetail: Starts at $69/mo. Institutional pricing available.

tools.name: Curipod
tools.description: AI-powered interactive lesson creator with polls, word clouds, drawing, and reflection prompts built for student engagement.
values: Students interact in real-time - polls, drawings, word clouds
AI generates complete interactive lessons from a topic
Built-in reflection and check-for-understanding prompts
tools.priceDetail: Free for basic use. Premium unlocks AI generation and advanced features.

tools.name: Gradescope
tools.description: AI-assisted grading platform. Upload assignments, create rubrics, and grade consistently across hundreds of submissions.
values: AI groups similar answers - grade once, apply to all matches
Rubric-based grading ensures consistency across sections and TAs
Handles handwritten work, code, and STEM notation
tools.priceDetail: Institutional licensing through Turnitin. Contact for pricing.
tools.bestFor: Faculty with large sections or multiple TAs who need consistent, efficient grading.
strengths: Dramatically reduces grading time for large classes
AI grouping catches patterns humans miss
limitations: Institutional license required - can't self-serve easily
Learning curve for initial rubric setup
Best for structured assessments, less useful for open-ended projects
tools.quickstart: Start by uploading a past exam. Create your rubric, then use AI-assisted grouping to batch-grade similar responses.

tools.name: Turnitin
tools.description: Academic integrity platform with AI writing detection, plagiarism checking, and Feedback Studio for formative assessment.
values: Industry-standard AI writing detection with confidence scores
Similarity reports cross-reference billions of sources
Feedback Studio enables inline comments and rubric scoring
tools.priceDetail: Institutional licensing only. Contact sales for pricing.

tools.name: Formative
tools.description: Real-time formative assessment with AI-powered feedback, live student monitoring, and data-driven instructional insights.
values: See student responses in real-time as they work
AI provides instant feedback so students don't wait for grading
Data dashboard reveals class-wide understanding gaps
tools.priceDetail: Free for basic use. Premium for AI features and advanced analytics.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.description: AI-powered academic search engine. Finds and synthesizes insights from peer-reviewed papers - no marketing content mixed in.
values: Only searches peer-reviewed papers - no blog posts or SEO content
Synthesizes findings across multiple studies into a summary
Great teaching tool for modeling proper research methodology
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with limited searches. Premium at $8.99/mo for unlimited.

tools.name: Elicit
tools.description: AI research assistant for literature reviews. Automates paper finding, summarization, and data extraction across millions of papers.
values: Extracts key findings, methods, and sample sizes from papers automatically
Builds structured evidence tables from search results
Saves hours of manual literature review work
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 5,000 credits. Plus at $12/mo for higher limits.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.description: AI writing assistant for grammar, tone, and clarity. Works across platforms to help produce polished, professional writing.
values: Tone detection helps match academic register expectations
Works in email, LMS, Google Docs - catches errors everywhere
Explains grammar rules - doubles as a learning tool
tools.priceDetail: Free for basic grammar. Premium at $12/mo adds tone, clarity, and plagiarism checks.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.description: AI presentation creator. Describe what you need, get polished slides with smart layout, design, and content structure.
values: Creates a full slide deck from a text description in minutes
Designs look professional - not the typical AI-generated aesthetic
Exports to PowerPoint for final editing in familiar tools
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 400 AI credits. Plus at $8/mo for unlimited.

tools.name: Mentimeter
tools.description: Interactive presentation platform with live polls, quizzes, Q&A, and word clouds for real-time audience engagement.
values: Students respond from their phones - no app download needed
Live word clouds and polls make large lectures interactive
Quiz mode adds gamification without needing a separate tool
tools.priceDetail: Free for 2 question types. Education plan at $11.99/mo with unlimited features.

tools.name: Slidesgo
tools.description: AI-enhanced presentation templates for Google Slides and PowerPoint. Professional designs with customizable layouts.
values: Thousands of education-specific templates available free
AI generates slide content from topic descriptions
Works natively with Google Slides - no new platform to learn
tools.priceDetail: Free templates available. Premium at $4.99/mo for full library.

tools.name: Canva
tools.description: AI-enhanced design platform. Presentations, infographics, social media, videos, and visual content with thousands of templates.
values: Canva for Education is free for verified educators
Magic Design AI creates layouts from your content automatically
One platform for slides, posters, social media, and video
tools.priceDetail: Free tier. Canva for Education free for K-12 and higher ed. Pro at $12.99/mo.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.description: Leading AI image generator. Known for artistic quality and creative control. Create illustrations, diagrams, and visual concepts.
values: Highest aesthetic quality of any AI image generator
Great for custom course illustrations and visual metaphors
Style controls let you match institutional brand guidelines
tools.priceDetail: Basic at $10/mo. Standard at $30/mo with more generations.

tools.name: RunwayML
tools.description: Professional AI video generation and editing. Text-to-video, image-to-video, and advanced manipulation tools.
values: Generate short video clips from text descriptions
Remove backgrounds, extend scenes, and edit with AI tools
Strong for creating visual content for online courses
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 125 credits. Standard at $12/mo for 625 credits.

tools.name: Synthesia
tools.description: AI video creation with realistic virtual presenters. Create training and lecture videos without cameras, studios, or editing skills.
values: Create professional talking-head videos without filming
160+ AI avatars and 130+ languages for global accessibility
Perfect for standardized training and orientation content
tools.priceDetail: Starter at $22/mo. Enterprise plans with custom avatars.

tools.name: Pika Labs
tools.description: AI video generation from text and images. Creative, stylized output for educational and project content.
values: Generate video from still images - animate diagrams and illustrations
Stylized output works well for creative assignments
Simple interface - low barrier for first-time users
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with daily credits. Standard at $8/mo.

tools.name: Descript
tools.description: Edit audio and video by editing text. Automatic transcription, filler word removal, screen recording, and podcast editing.
values: Edit video by editing the transcript - revolutionary for lecture editing
Automatic filler word and silence removal
Screen recording + webcam for creating instructional content
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 1 hour of transcription. Pro at $24/mo.

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.description: AI avatar video platform. Create talking-head videos with custom avatars, voice cloning, and multilingual translation.
values: Clone your own likeness for consistent video presence
Translate videos into 40+ languages automatically
Scale video content without re-recording
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 1 credit. Creator at $24/mo.

tools.name: Fliki
tools.description: Turn text into videos with AI voices, stock media, and captions. Fast content creation for educational materials.
values: Blog post to video in minutes - repurpose written content
2000+ realistic AI voices across 75+ languages
Auto-generates captions for accessibility compliance
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 5 minutes/mo. Standard at $28/mo.

tools.name: Sora
tools.description: OpenAI's text-to-video model. Generates realistic, high-quality video from text descriptions.
values: Highest quality AI video generation currently available
Create realistic scenario videos for case studies and simulations
Part of OpenAI ecosystem - works with ChatGPT workflows
tools.priceDetail: Included with ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo) and Pro ($200/mo).

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.description: AI image generator with exceptional text rendering. Create visuals with accurate, readable embedded text.
values: Best AI tool for images that include readable text
Great for creating custom infographics and diagrams
Free tier is one of the most generous available
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 10 generations/day. Plus at $7/mo.

tools.name: RemoveBG
tools.description: AI background removal. One click to remove image backgrounds for presentations, materials, and design projects.
values: One-click background removal - no Photoshop needed
Batch processing for multiple images at once
API available for integration into workflows
tools.priceDetail: Free for preview quality. Credits start at $0.20/image for HD.

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.description: AI writing and organization built into Notion. Draft, edit, summarize, and brainstorm within your workspace.
values: AI works inside your existing notes and documents - no copy-pasting
Summarize meeting notes, research, or student feedback instantly
Template gallery includes academic-specific workflows
tools.priceDetail: Notion AI add-on at $10/member/mo on top of workspace plan.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.description: AI meeting notes. Automated transcription, action item tracking, and real-time collaboration for meetings and lectures.
values: Auto-transcribes meetings and lectures with speaker identification
Generates action items and key takeaways automatically
Integrates with Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet
tools.priceDetail: Free for 300 minutes/mo. Pro at $16.99/mo for 1200 minutes.

tools.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
tools.description: Microsoft's AI integrated across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook. Draft, summarize, and analyze where you work.
values: Works inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook - your existing tools
Summarize email threads and meeting transcripts instantly
Generate presentations from Word documents automatically
tools.priceDetail: $30/user/mo on top of Microsoft 365 subscription. Institutional licensing available.

tools.name: Suno
tools.description: AI music generation. Create full songs with vocals, instruments, and lyrics from text prompts. Powerful for creative projects.
values: Generate complete songs with vocals from a text description
Great for multimedia projects and creative course content
Students can explore music composition without instruments
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with 10 songs/day. Pro at $10/mo for 500 songs.

tools.name: Quizlet
tools.description: AI-enhanced study platform. Flashcards, practice tests, and personalized learning paths for effective exam preparation.
values: AI generates practice questions from any study material
Spaced repetition algorithm optimizes long-term retention
Faculty can create shared sets for entire courses
tools.priceDetail: Free basic features. Quizlet Plus at $7.99/mo for AI features.

tools.name: QuillBot
tools.description: AI paraphrasing, grammar checking, and summarizing. Helps students refine writing while maintaining original meaning.
values: Paraphrasing modes teach different registers of academic writing
Summarizer condenses research articles to key points
Grammar checker explains rules - builds writing skills over time
tools.priceDetail: Free tier with basic features. Premium at $9.95/mo.

tools.name: Kahoot!
tools.description: Game-based learning platform with AI quiz generation. Creates engaging, competitive learning experiences for any subject.
values: AI generates complete quizzes from any topic or document
Live game mode energizes even the most reluctant students
Works for in-person, hybrid, and asynchronous formats
tools.priceDetail: Free for basic quizzes. Kahoot+ starts at $3/mo for advanced features.

tools.name: Knowt
tools.description: AI study tool that converts notes and lectures into flashcards and practice quizzes automatically.
values: Upload lecture notes or slides - AI generates study materials
Creates both flashcards and practice tests from the same content
Free for students - no institutional license needed
tools.priceDetail: Free for students. Premium features available.
